title: Quietly Crispy Egyptian Kimchi Wrap
description: A lazy Sunday Egyptian dish featuring whipping cream and ferment-kimchi, wrapped in a lotus leaf, this satvik-friendly meal is perfect for a relaxing day. It combines herbal and crispy elements for a unique flavor experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Rinse the lotus leaves and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a bowl, mix together the ferment-kimchi, whipping cream, parsley, dill, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Spoon about 1/2 cup of the kimchi mixture onto the center of each lotus leaf.
Brush the edges of the lotus leaf with olive oil.
Fold the stem end of the leaf over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the leaf into a tight cylinder.
Place the wraps seam-side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the leaves are crispy and golden brown.
Serve the wraps hot, garnished with additional parsley and dill if desired.
